title: Suicide Bunny King's Crown Claim Your Throne Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Wonderful butterscotch eliquids are few and far between, which is why this delicious juice from Suicide Bunny truly Claims the Crown thanks to its rich butterscotch flavour, dense with dark brown sugar and softened with smooth, luxurious cream. King's Crown is a gourmet E-Liquid line from vape legends Suicide Bunny that feature majestic combinations of sweet fruits, decadent desserts and refreshing beverages. This convenient 50ml shortfill bottle comes with 10ml of free space for the addition of a nicotine shot to tailor your vape’s nicotine content to your exact preference. Its 70VG/30PG ratio makes it ideal for high-powered pod kits , mods and sub-ohm tanks .
